pages.title: Void Lattice Shard
pages.text: A splinter of the scaffolding that sits between branes, the structure the Bulk uses to keep separate universes apart. It has edges but no obvious inside, and light that enters it takes a long time to come back out. Held close to the ear it hums at a pitch just below hearing.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)The first shards fell from a Void Wraith I fought near a bulk monolith, still crackling. Later I found them in derelict station lockers and learned to break them out of Void Lattice Blocks directly, which is quieter than fighting for them.

Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Mined$(): from $(item)Void Lattice Ore$(), in veins through the Bulk.$(br2)$(thing)Dropped by$(): Brane Strider, Graviton Wisp, Moduli Crawler, Void Wraith.$(br2)$(thing)Found in$(): Bulk Monolith, Calabi Yau Knot chests.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Thermodynamics of Information.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Bubble Pedestal, Calabi-Yau Manifold, Dark Matter, Dark Matter Lens, Empirical Notes III, Empty Set, Exotic Matter Crystal, Exotic Matter Singularity and more.
